blocks.text:
The trip brings together several very different experiences. City panoramas and a night at Carnival give way to the tropical forest and 275 cascades of Iguazú Falls. Then the schedule opens up. In Angra dos Reis, you can spend time on the beach, go out on the water, dive, surf or fish.

In Rio, you see the city from its two best-known viewpoints. Sugarloaf looks out over the bay and the ocean, while Corcovado takes in the densely built city, its beaches and the mountains around Christ the Redeemer. Between the two excursions comes Carnival night at the Sambadrome. Each of the first four days has a different focus, with sightseeing, the historic centre and the main Carnival event.

English-speaking guides lead the key excursions and help you navigate the itinerary, transfers and main sights along the way. The programme includes the main transfers, Carnival tickets and return transport between the hotel and the Sambadrome. You can choose optional outings in Rio and Iguazú separately.

The order of the itinerary lets the pace change gradually. Rio comes first, with a busy city programme and Carnival. Iguazú follows, with national parks and long walks along boardwalks by the water. The coast comes last, so the beach days have their own place in the trip without taking time away from sightseeing.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The Word lists these excursions and inclusions across separate itinerary days, but has no equivalent to this full route overview, the comparison between viewpoints or its explanation of the changing pace.
